metadata.title: Advanced Topics in Modern Microscopy Techniques
metadata.description: A learning graph for EE 5940, a graduate course on the engineering of modern optical microscopes: wave optics and the point spread function, instrument optics, image sensors and noise, contrast hardware, sampling, laser-scanning and nonlinear systems, adaptive optics, computational restoration, quantitative analysis, and machine learning for smart microscopy.
metadata.creator: Hye Yoon Park
